$comment: Advisories that CI accepts even though `npm audit` reports them.
An entry is only justified while the vulnerable version is pinned outside this repository's control.
Each entry is matched exactly: advisory, module, severity, range, and every reported dependency path.
Anything else fails the audit gate, including an entry that no longer matches a reported advisory.
`reviewBy` time-boxes the exception. CI fails once that date passes, forcing a fresh decision instead of silent drift.
See docs/dependency-audit.md before adding, changing, or extending an entry.

exceptions.reason: brace-expansion is pinned by the npm-shrinkwrap.json published inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. A dependency shrinkwrap is authoritative for its own subtree, so neither a root overrides entry nor `npm audit fix` can raise it to the patched 5.0.8. Pi 0.82.1 still ships 5.0.7. The package is a development dependency used by the local toolchain and CI on trusted repository inputs, and it is never shipped in the published npm package, which declares Pi as a peer dependency.
exceptions.upstreamFix: Requires @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to bump brace-expansion to >=5.0.8 in its shrinkwrap.
